title: Migrate website from Hugo to Zola with GitHub Pages deployment
description: Complete migration to Zola static site generator with custom mstratsec.biz domain, implementing business card graphic chart and automated GitHub Actions deployment

title: Update flake.nix with Zola and source filtering
description: Replace Hugo with Zola in flake.nix. Add lib.fileset.toSource to filter source (exclude .git/, cv/, generation_carte_visite/, LFS pointers). Remove dead lettre package. Change packages.default from cv to blog. Update devShell to provide zola instead of hugo.

title: Create Zola site structure
description: Initialize Zola directory structure: config.toml (with base_url=https://mstratsec.biz/), content/_index.md, templates/base.html, templates/index.html, sass/style.scss, static/ directory, static/CNAME (containing mstratsec.biz)

title: Implement custom theme with business card graphic chart
description: Create SCSS with design tokens from business_card_vec.py: colors (#1a1a1a, #D4A017, #A0A0A0, #F5F5F5), font stacks ('Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif), layout matching business card (gold lines, company name, taglines, contact info, optional motto). Ensure responsive design.

title: Add GitHub Actions workflow with LFS support
description: Create .github/workflows/deploy.yml with: trigger on push to master, actions/checkout@v4 with lfs:true (unconditional), nix build .#blog, upload-pages-artifact, deploy-pages. Include permissions (pages:write, id-token:write, contents:read). Document custom domain setup prerequisites.

title: Create CLAUDE.md documentation
description: Document project conventions: tech stack (Zola/Nix/GitHub Actions), build commands (nix build, nix develop), graphic chart reference, Git LFS notes, custom domain setup (mstratsec.biz), beads tracker usage (br command), DNS configuration requirements.

title: Verify complete migration
description: Run verification checks: nix flake check, nix build .#blog (filtered source), nix build .#cv (regression), zola serve test, visual spot-check (colors/fonts/layout), workflow YAML validation, font-family in CSS output, CNAME file, base_url in config.toml
